how: The suggestions record's backtest, written by props/build/suggest_backtest.js by hand (never by a job): each night game (Thursday, Sunday or Monday at or after 7 pm Eastern) and Sunday slot (the week's Sunday games before 7 pm Eastern) of the weeks before the record took them, from week 3, rebuilt by today's rules (the page at the site's root) on exactly the files of the last commit on the main line before the unit's lock (2 hours before its kickoff, the slot's first), the clock at the lock less a minute, and graded on the results by the app's settleLeg as the record grades. Keyed and shaped as the record's prime and slot maps, each entry marked src backtest with the commit its files came from. The page counts a unit's level from the record where it has one, else from here. Never edited by hand: the file only grows, a unit once in it kept as it is but for its grades.
